name: First Atlas Resources Corp.
summary: First Atlas Resources Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold and lithium deposits, as well as hydrogen. It holds 100% interest in the MacKenzie East project located in the Quebec; and the Matane Hydrogen project in Quebec. The company was formerly known as Q Precious & Battery Metals Corp. and changed its name to First Atlas Resources Corp. in February 2026. First Atlas Resources Corp. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
